title: Rationalizable Behavior in Matching with Externalities
abstract: arXiv:2606.28028v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In many matching markets, agents care not only about their own partners but also about the matches formed by others. With externalities, stability depends on what agents believe would happen after a deviation. We introduce rationalizable conjectures: beliefs that survive iterated elimination, in the spirit of rationalizability in non-cooperative games. These beliefs define conjecture-rationalizable stability, a solution concept that always exists, extends Gale--Shapley stability, and coincides with it when externalities are absent. We also introduce rationalizable matchings, a non-equilibrium counterpart, and show that every conjecture-rationalizable stable matching is rationalizable. In matching with couples, our concept yields non-empty predictions even when standard stability is vacuous. translated_title: 带外部性匹配中的可合理化行为
translated_abstract: 在许多匹配市场中，参与者不仅关心自己的配对对象，还关心其他人之间形成的匹配。当存在外部性时，稳定性取决于参与者对偏离之后会发生什么的信念。我们引入了可合理化猜想：即在非合作博弈可合理性精神下，经过反复剔除后仍能存留的信念。这些信念定义了猜想-可合理化稳定性，这是一个总是存在的解概念，它扩展了Gale-Shapley稳定性，并且在外部性不存在时与之完全一致。我们还引入了可合理化匹配作为其非均衡对应概念，并证明每一个猜想-可合理化稳定匹配都是可合理化的。在夫妇匹配问题中，即使标准稳定性给出的预测为空，我们的概念仍能给出非空的预测。最后，我们提供了一个认知论基础：可合理性在行为上由成对理性以及关于成对理性的共同信念所蕴含。
tldr: 该论文针对带外部性的匹配市场提出了“猜想-可合理化稳定性”这一新的解概念，该概念保证非空存在、在无外部性时退化为经典的Gale-Shapley稳定性，并为其提供了基于成对理性与共同信念的认知论基础。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces conjecture-rationalizable stability, a new solution concept for matching markets with externalities that always exists, coincides with Gale-Shapley stability when externalities are absent, and is grounded in an epistemic foundation of pairwise rationality and common belief.
